releaseNotes: feat: Add new widgets and functionality for server management
changelog: Introduced new widgets: StatusPowerWidget, UptimeWidget, OverviewWidget, and ServerListWidget.
Implemented WidgetReceivers for the new widgets to handle user interactions.
Added PowerActionCallback to manage power actions (start, stop, restart) for servers.
Enhanced WidgetRegistry to include new widgets and their corresponding receivers.
Created XML configuration files for the new widgets to define their properties and layout.
Updated existing widget logic to accommodate new features and improve user experience.
